script_text: Venus, ruler of your Earth sign, sparks a midweek love explosion that changes everything. Monday and Tuesday, Venus in Virgo in your 5th House sextiles Mars in Cancer in your 3rd House—ideal for dating and career talks. Wednesday is risky: Mercury in Libra in your 6th House squares Pluto in Capricorn in your 9th House; delay contracts and salary talks. Thursday, the Sun in Scorpio in your 7th House opposes Uranus in Taurus in your 1st House—relationship versus identity breaking point. Friday through Sunday, Venus enters your 6th House and trines Jupiter in your 10th House of career; money arrives via side gig or office flirtation. Weekend Moon in your 2nd House says save, not spend. Tuesday is power day: Venus activates your 5th House for love. Wednesday is worst: Mercury square Pluto triggers financial power struggles. Sign nothing Wednesday, text your crush Tuesday. Follow for daily updates.
